tenDimensions.dim1_datasetSize: 2 Organizations, 2 Contests, 3 Problems, pre-seeded participants and standings

apiOverheadSeparation.description: Submission ingestion API immediately persists the submission and enqueues the job in PostgreSQL in 16ms median without waiting for Docker container startup. Docker container judging runs asynchronously on independent background workers.

bottleneckInvestigation.targetQuery: SELECT ... FROM "LeaderboardRow" WHERE "contestId" = $1 ORDER BY "score" DESC, "penaltyTimeSec" ASC
bottleneckInvestigation.problemBeforeIndex: PostgreSQL execution engine previously executed a Bitmap Index Scan on contestId followed by an explicit Sort node (quicksort in PostgreSQL work_mem memory) to order rows by score DESC and penaltyTimeSec ASC.
bottleneckInvestigation.optimizationApplied: Added composite index: CREATE INDEX idx_leaderboard_perf ON "LeaderboardRow" ("contestId", "score" DESC, "penaltyTimeSec" ASC);
bottleneckInvestigation.behaviorAfterIndex: PostgreSQL uses index-ordered access, eliminating the CPU and memory cost of PostgreSQL in-memory sorting.
